items.hook: "Diary of a Madman", also translated as "A Madman's Diary" is a short story by the Chinese writer Lu Xun, published in 1918.
items.body: It was an early work written in vernacular Chinese in Republican-era China and became associated with the New Culture Movement. One of those things you can't un-know.
